text.en: Visitors! Excellent. Leave your valuables on the counter. The consultation is nonrefundable.
text.zh-CN: 有客人！太好了。值钱的东西请放柜台，诊金概不退还。

text.en: A mugging with office hours. That's a new one.
text.zh-CN: 还有按时营业的打劫，这倒是头一回见。

text.en: That last move... that's from my missing pages.
text.zh-CN: 刚才那一招……就在我缺的那两页里。

text.en: Looks like your notes have been keeping this business afloat. Hand them over.
text.zh-CN: 看来这门生意还靠你的笔记撑着。把它们交出来吧。

text.en: Fine. A refund. My least favorite treatment.
text.zh-CN: 好吧，退款。这可是我最不喜欢的疗法。

text.en: And the bottle in the cupboard? Call it compensation for the consultation.
text.zh-CN: 柜子里的那瓶呢？就算这次问诊的补偿吧。

text.en: Last-Light Remedy. Take it. And don't tell anyone I gave a refund.
text.zh-CN: 余光灵药。拿去吧，别告诉别人我还退过诊金。

text.en: Two pages and a remedy. A productive appointment.
text.zh-CN: 两页笔记和一瓶灵药，今天这趟没白来。

text.en: I've had more profitable days treating splinters.
text.zh-CN: 我给人挑木刺，都比今天赚得多。

text.en: Then try charging for those instead.
text.zh-CN: 那还是靠挑木刺收钱吧。

text.en: Please don't touch the ice pieces. They're almost a word.
text.zh-CN: 先别碰那些冰片。就快拼成一个词了。

text.en: Your fighting notes have a suspiciously large blank in the middle.
text.zh-CN: 你的战技笔记中间，好像空了很大一块。

text.en: A friendly match might help. We can test the parts you still have.
text.zh-CN: 不如友好切磋一场，先试试你手头还有的部分。

text.en: Two pages are missing. If the answer is 'duck,' I'd rather learn it now.
text.zh-CN: 少了两页。要是上面写着‘记得低头’，最好现在就让我学会。

text.en: Well fought. I'm Kai. I suspect the missing pages covered that.
text.zh-CN: 打得漂亮。我叫凯。我怀疑少掉的那两页正好讲这个。

text.en: Let's find them before you have to improvise the rest.
text.zh-CN: 一起找回来吧，免得后面全靠你临场发挥。

text.en: Gladly. If Gerda asks, this was studying. Definitely not getting knocked over.
text.zh-CN: 好。要是格尔达问起，就说我在学习，绝不是被人打趴下了。

text.en: Let's call that a first draft. Check your footing before the next one.
text.zh-CN: 这回就算初稿。下次先看准脚下。

找回了两页胡家刀法。.en: Recovered Kai's missing Frontier Cleave Pages and a Last-Light Remedy at the Apothecary's Hut.
找回了两页胡家刀法。.zh-CN: 在药师小舍找回凯缺失的边境重斩残页，并获得一份余光灵药。

答应帮胡斐找回两页刀法。.en: Kai joined the party. We agreed to look for two missing pages from his fighting notes.
答应帮胡斐找回两页刀法。.zh-CN: 凯加入队伍，我们答应帮他找回战技笔记缺失的两页。
